headline: HuyenBao v11.25 — Cộng đồng: chat + bạn bè + tặng quà + BXH toàn cầu (Supabase / demo 2 tab)
summary: PLAYER-TO-PLAYER COMMUNITY. A new 'Cộng đồng / Community' group lands with three tabs: (1) Chat — global room with live presence (online list), realtime via Supabase, Enter-to-send, flood guard. (2) Bạn bè / Friends — add friends by player code (HB-XXXXXX), accept/decline requests, remove, and GIFT money to friends (deducted on send, claimed from the gift inbox); unread badge dot on the nav. (3) Bảng xếp hạng / Leaderboard — top 50 players by net worth with medals, own-row highlight, auto-sync while playing. BACKEND: when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are set at build time, everything runs on Supabase (free Postgres) with anonymous auth + full Row Level Security (schema: /hb-supabase-schema.sql — players, messages, friend edges, gifts; every write scoped to its owner; realtime channel for chat + presence). Without env vars the game ships a zero-config demo mode: same-device tabs sync via BroadcastChannel + localStorage so two tabs can chat, friend and gift each other — and the Friends tab carries a built-in 5-step setup guide + downloadable SQL so switching to real multiplayer is copy-paste. Identity: display name + emoji avatar + player code, stored per browser.
features: COMMUNITY: new nav group 'Cộng đồng / Community / 社区' with 3 tabs — Chat, Bạn bè (Friends), Bảng xếp hạng (Leaderboard)
CHAT: global room, live online-presence list, auto-scroll, Enter to send, 280-char cap + 1.2s flood guard
FRIENDS: add by player code HB-XXXXXX (mutual requests auto-accept), accept/decline/remove, online dot per friend
GIFTS: send money to friends (deducted at send, claimed from inbox) — claim credits the local wallet via the standard act() pipeline
LEADERBOARD: top 50 by net worth, medals for top 3, own row highlighted, stats auto-push (30s throttle) while playing
NOTIFICATIONS: friend requests + unclaimed gifts toast in the background (45s sweep) and light up a red dot on the Friends nav tab
SUPABASE BACKEND: anonymous auth (stable per-browser identity) + RLS policies on 4 tables (players/messages/edges/gifts) — anon key is safe to expose
REALTIME: Supabase channel for chat INSERTs + presence sync; polling fallbacks (messages 30s, notifications 45s)
DEMO MODE (no env vars): BroadcastChannel + localStorage — two tabs on one device interact fully; setup guide + SQL download built into the Friends tab
IDENTITY: display name (≤24 chars) + 12 emoji avatars + unambiguous player code (no I/O/0/1), editable profile card
i18n: ~50 new strings × EN/VI/ZH, nav tooltips (ttab.*) included
Version bumped to v11.25 at FRONT of app name
